plan.notes: Transcribed from the official CRC 'Biology AS-T Degree' program map, Catalog Year 2026-2027, published September 23, 2026 (mapmaker.losrios.edu/Maps/8042/PublishedPdf). GE Pattern: Cal-GETC. Map states Total Units 61-62; lower bound 61 encoded = 15+16+15+15 (semester sums verified at lower bound: Sem 1 MATH 355/MATH 400 -> 4). MATH CHOICE: MATH 355 Calculus for Biology and Medicine I (4 units; pre-req MATH 335) or MATH 400 Calculus I (5 units; pre-req MATH 370 or MATH 372 AND Math 373); lower bound 4 encoded. Option-specific math prerequisites documented here, not encoded on the choice slot. CHEM 400 pre-req per map: Intermediate Algebra and CHEM 300, 305, 309 or 1 year of high school chemistry with lab (prior chemistry and algebra placement; documented here, not encoded as plan prerequisites). BIOL 400 pre-req per map: CHEM 400 or 305 and Intermediate algebra; encoded as one_of CHEM 400/CHEM 305 (CHEM 305 carried under external_prereqs). PHYS 350 pre-req per map: MATH 335 (carried under external_prereqs). Advisories (recommended, not required): BIOL 400, BIOL 410, BIOL 420 advisory eligibility for ENGL C1000. CalGETC Area 4 footnote: a total of 6 units from 2 disciplines to satisfy Area 4 (one 3-unit Area 4 course sequenced in each of Semesters 3 and 4). Students wishing to transfer to a UC Biology program should meet with a counselor; additional chemistry, physics, and math courses may be required. CalGETC Area 1A: map recommends meeting with a counselor.
